description: The browser.ssi subset for Nostr protocol. Requires `ssi.nostr` along with `ssi` to set permissions.

types.description: The preference values set by the user in `about:selfsovereignindividual`

events.name: onPrefEnabledChanged
events.description: Fire when the preference value of `selfsovereignindividual.nostr.enabled` changed

returns.description: A Promise that will be fulfilled with a `object` of `ssi.nostr.Preference`. Returns Promise\<null\> if error.

functions.name: sign
functions.description: Pass message and return the signature by Nostr secret key. You should always read the public key without using cache just before sign/encrypt/decrypt, as the user may change their primary key without notifying you. During the execution process, an internal authorization check is performed similar to `browser.ssi.askConsent`.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to sign. If it's not a string it must be stringified.

returns.description: A Promise that will be fulfilled with a `string` of resulting signature. Returns Promise\<null\> if error.

functions.name: encrypt
functions.description: Pass plain text and return the cipher text by Nostr secret key. You should always read the public key without using cache just before sign/encrypt/decrypt, as the user may change their primary key without notifying you. During the execution process, an internal authorization check is performed similar to `browser.ssi.askConsent`.

pubkey.description: The conversation partner's public key. If type is 'nip04' or 'nip44', then this is required.

version.description: The version to define encryption algorithms if the type is 'nip44'.

returns.description: A Promise that will be fulfilled with a `string` of the encrypted cipher text. Returns Promise\<null\> if error.

functions.name: decrypt
functions.description: Pass cipher text and return the plain text by Nostr secret key. You should always read the public key without using cache just before sign/encrypt/decrypt, as the user may change their primary key without notifying you. During the execution process, an internal authorization check is performed similar to `browser.ssi.askConsent`.

pubkey.description: The conversation partner's public key. If type is 'nip04' or 'nip44', then this is required.

version.description: The version to define encryption algorithms if the type is 'nip44'.

returns.description: A Promise that will be fulfilled with a `string` of the decrypted plain text. Returns Promise\<null\> if error.
